steps: Initial open -n failed before process start with Launch Services -10810. Its plist used a dev-string CFBundleVersion; corrected isolated metadata to numeric 1, re-signed, and open -n still returned -10810. The exact packaged executable launched directly with the isolated --app-dir and fixture folder.
Created a 32 x 32, 8-bit sRGB layered document. Save As to new native-detach.tessera-doc succeeded; AX canvas status said Saved native-detach.tessera-doc, file size 1001 bytes.
Reopened Save As, clicked Cancel: sheet dismissed and editor remained. Reopened with Command-Shift-S, pressed Escape: sheet dismissed and editor remained.

Reopened Save As on the same existing path and clicked Save. The sheet dismissed; no Replace alert appeared. AX and screenshot showed the editor and the previous Saved status. The original document hash remained a38faab3... .
Immediately pressing Command-Shift-S caused no AX change. Explicit File > Save As remained enabled, but clicking it showed no sheet. This is an additional stalled successor presentation symptom.

File > Close Document closed the editor. Open Document on the saved file reopened it, and then a delayed Save As sheet appeared over the reopened editor. Clicked Cancel; AX status behind it said Opened native-detach.tessera-doc.
Fresh Save As to distinct existing already-exists.tessera-doc dismissed without a Replace alert or new status. Both existing file hashes remained a38faab3... .

Command-Q closed the isolated app. A CUA state query relaunched the bound app once; a second Command-Q without a follow-up UI query stopped it. No isolated process remained; normal preview PID 57591 was still running.
not_verified: Replace Cancel and confirmed Replace, because no alert appeared
Readable reopened replacement output; only original saved document reopened
Abrupt parent-window destruction and preappearance cancellation
evidence_limits: CUA AX trees and one screenshot were displayed during the run but not exported as image files. A missing native/Swift dismissal callback is a hypothesis, not established root cause.
